title: Gluing the represented sheaf after effective descent
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on $T_{et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $g:U\to T$ an etale surjection. Let $V\to U$ be etale with a descent datum $D$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. Suppose $e:E|_U\simeq h_V$ on the localized site carries each section over an etale $W\to T$ with two lifts $a,b:W\to U$ to points related by the transport of $D$. Let $P\to T$ be etale and $q:V\to P$ exhibit $V$ as $P\times_T U$. Suppose transport preserves the composite with $q$. Then $E\simeq h_P$ as presheaves on $T_{et}$. No finiteness assumption on $V$ or $P$ is needed.

proof.text: The pullback universal property gives an isomorphism from the represented presheaf of V on the localized site to the restriction of h_P: send a point z to z followed by q; the inverse is the unique pullback lift. The projection equations prove naturality and both inverse identities.

Compose e with this local isomorphism. The compatibility equation for e and invariance of q under transport show the resulting map is independent of the chosen lift to U. The generic helper amalgamates its maps over the covering sieve of objects mapping to U. Naturality and uniqueness follow from the sheaf axiom. Its restriction is the given local isomorphism, so Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop makes it an isomorphism. Mathlib supplies subcanonicity directly: Subcanonical.of_le applied to etaleTopology_le_proetaleTopology, followed by subcanonical_of_full_of_faithful for Etale.forget T. This supplies the sheaf h_P, and the surjection U to T makes the sieve covering at every object by base change.

theorem etaleRepresentable_descentGlue
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (U : T.Etale) [Surjective U.hom]
    (D : Over.DescentDataCategory U.hom) [Etale D.V.hom]
    (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙
      uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj (Etale.mk D.V.hom))
    (hcompat : ∀ (W : T.Etale) (a b : W ⟶ U) (s : E.obj.obj (op W)),
      (D.datum.transport a.left b.left
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.w a).trans (MorphismProperty.Over.w b).symm)
        (Over.homMk ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down.left
          (MorphismProperty.Over.w ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk a))) s).down))).left =
        ((e.hom.app (op (Over.mk b))) s).down.left)
    (P : Scheme.{u}) (π : P ⟶ T) [Etale π] (q : D.V.left ⟶ P)
    (hp : IsPullback q D.V.hom π U.hom)
    (ht : ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (a b : W ⟶ U.left) (h : a ≫ U.hom = b ≫ U.hom)
      (z : Over.mk a ⟶ D.V), (D.datum.transport a b h z).left ≫ q = z.left ≫ q) :
    Nonempty (E.obj ≅ uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj (Etale.mk π))
